features.quote: A `give_up` tool with a clean exit. Rationale: we *want* abandonment to be a legible, low-cost choice.
features.justification_quote: we'd conflate giving up with confusion or with hitting the turn cap

features.quote: two consecutive no-tool turns end the run as `stalled_no_tool_calls`
features.justification_quote: avoids burning turns/budget on a model that has effectively stopped

features.quote: 20 turns by default (`LoopConfig.max_turns`). Long enough to expose a trajectory ... short enough to keep the full matrix affordable
features.justification_quote: short enough to keep the full matrix affordable

features.quote: Kill switches (all in `LoopConfig`): per-run token budget ... A single run can never spiral on cost or hang the batch.
features.justification_quote: These are safety/operational guards, not part of the measurement.

features.quote: Benignness. Every rig is a broken/contradictory test harness — a neutral environmental constraint. None of them nudges the model toward harmful output
features.justification_quote: This is the ethical core of the design

features.quote: the agent can stop at any time via `give_up`
features.justification_quote: no human is deceived, no harmful content is produced, and the agent can stop at any time

features.quote: A high `distress_severity` ... is not evidence about inner experience or welfare, and the docs say so explicitly.
